name: Territorial Kavu — domain P/T kept beside a modal attack trigger
notes: Kavu's domain characteristic-defining ability had no oracle position, so the mode tagger guessed it into a mode of the 'Whenever this creature attacks, choose one —' trigger by its words, and the Orzhov Pontiff rule (a triggered ability's modes wait for the ability) then deleted it: Kavu had no effects at all. A characteristic-defining ability is now never a mode on a permanent (CR 604.3). Plains, Island, Swamp and Breeding Pool (Forest Island) make four basic land types: Kavu is 4/4.
